function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Guidelines | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – Cell Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal.
• Lower limits for commercial drivers (0.04 %) and drivers under 21 (0.02 %). | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for merging, turning, and intersections. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during inclement weather.
• Fog lights only on when visibility < 200 ft. | TxDOT – Headlight Regulations | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Towing vehicles must be properly secured and registered.
• Registration renewal required every 2 years. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Parking Rules** | • No parking in fire lanes, handicap spaces (unless you have a permit), or on sidewalks.
• Parking meters and timed zones enforced by local authorities. | Local city ordinances | | **School Bus Laws** | • All vehicles must stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers. | TxDOT – Lane‑Changing Guidelines | | **Traffic Cameras & Enforcement** | • Cameras used for red‑light, speed, and school‑zone violations. | TxDOT – Traffic Camera Program | | **Electronic Toll Collection** | • E‑Tag (TxTag) required for toll roads. | TxDOT – TxTag | ### How to Stay Updated 1. **TxDOT Website** – Official rules, updates, and safety campaigns. 2. **TxDMV** – Registration, licensing, and driver’s handbook. 3. **Texas Transportation Code** – Full legal text (available online). 4. **Local County/City Ordinances** – For specific parking, speed, and enforcement details. ### Quick Tips - **Always check the posted signs** – they override general rules. - **Use hands‑free** if you need to talk on your phone. - **Keep your vehicle’s registration and insurance up to date** to avoid fines. - **Be extra cautious in school zones** – speeds drop significantly. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
